runs.scope: All tests collected before adding the two production-width architecture cases; final v32 core and notebook were tested.
All v32 cases, including the two additional production-width cases; overlaps 11 cases in the full-suite run.

verification.warnings: Two existing PyTorch nested-tensor warnings in older model tests; no failures in the final verification runs.
new_model_checks: ASL matches weighted BCE with zero clipping/gamma, handles soft mixup labels and finite extreme-logit gradients
Clipped easy negatives produce zero negative gradient
Rare branch membership depends only on training labels; held-out-label changes cannot alter it or initialized weights
Rare residual is identity-initialized and its final layer receives gradients
Both actual width-192 specialist architectures complete forward/backward passes with 5016 outputs and canonical raw sensor shapes
22 fusion policies preserve each row count, leading 60 percent and the selected replacement cap
Policy selection does not inspect assessment predictions and rejects outside-core regression
runtime_and_pipeline: GPU error occurs before feature loading
Runtime estimate includes all active production models and a 1.5x margin plus 45 minutes
Real miniature training runs frozen reference groups, five new development members on two folds and all five production members
Every miniature production model uses every PA row; no production calibration anchors are removed
Production admission failure prevents any production training
Rejected policy emits byte-identical control under DO_NOT_SUBMIT, not a ready submission
Real calibration, bounded decoding, submission validation, compact export and output hashing exercised
Forced export failure revokes the ready CSV and writes an ineligible failure report
Version-owned temporary runtime directory is removed on success and failures
verification.miniature_scope_warning: Synthetic 32-row CPU fixture with one epoch and width 16; policy and reference predictions are controlled to exercise acceptance. Full-width architecture checks are separate. These are software checks, not measured model accuracy or full T4 runtime.

limitations: No full T4 execution or guarantee of leaderboard improvement or winning
The 10.75-hour guard is cooperative and can stop a slow session instead of completing
All 88987 PA IDs were already consumed in development; gates do not create a fresh independent audit
Frozen counts and leading species may limit a useful larger improvement
Full-data probability calibration is transferred from previous seeds or development folds
